notes.title: Update 20250926-1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/090849257f5ecdbc0af94582135b209a09be8663.png[/img]

A small update including a few miscellaneous improvements and fixes :

[h3][b]GAME CUSTOMIZATION ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
Four new game customization options have been added:[list]
    [*]It is now possible to adjust the maximum amount of the player's life gauge between 150 (easy mode), 100 (normal mode), and 75 (hard mode)
    [*]It is now possible to adjust the maximum amount of the player's satiety gauge between 150 (easy mode), 100 (normal mode), and 75 (hard mode)
    [*]Fuel efficiency can now be adjusted : they will be twice as efficient in easy mode, and half as efficient in hard mode (no change for normal mode)
    [*]The player will now lose part of their inventory in their sarcophagus :
[list]
    [*]They will keep their entire inventory in easy mode
    [*]10% of their inventory will be destroyed in Normal Mode
    [*]30% of your inventory will be destroyed in Hard Mode[/list][/list]
[h3][b]GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Increased the number of iron rocks on planets (+30%)
    [*]Increased the number of copper rocks on planets (+50%)
[/list]
[h3][b]INTERFACE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Added the ability to rename saved games
    [*]Adjusted the display of resources collected from the ground in the center of the screen if the "Show Actions" option is disabled
[/list]
[h3][b]MOBS ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Adult non-aggressive creatures (Fatosaurus, Lamouths, and Rabrels) will now need to be fed multiple times for them to regenerate their wool, milk, or substrate.
[/list]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an anomaly that could occur when using the shield while the player activated it while on his hoverboard
[/list]
The full list of features in this update is available [url=https://discord.gg/BKMgAhjs]on our Discord[/url].

We look forward to your feedback to see if these adjustments work for you !

See you soon !

notes.title: Exotian Logbook
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/369c26d3acde6e214c3034d02cf38cf5405735ad.png[/img]

Hello everyone !

After a busy summer, we're back to bring you news about the expansion of the Exot galaxy 😁
We hope you were able to rest before heading back to work !

We're a little behind schedule, and the multiplayer development, although it has made considerable progress, is not yet finalized.
That's why we've decided to deploy a small interim update in the meantime to continue developing Exot 🙂

After careful consideration within our small team, we've decided to stop access to the Demo, at least for the time being.
Updating the Demo alongside the multiplayer development is currently taking up too much of our time, and we've chosen to prioritize Exot's progress toward its final version.
The Demo will no longer be accessible starting September 28th : ​​your games will still be accessible with the Early Access version 😉

Streams and videos will resume very soon on Twitch and YouTube after this summer break 😁
To make sure you don't miss a thing, don't hesitate to follow us on our social networks !

See you soon !

notes.title: Update 20250912-3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/090849257f5ecdbc0af94582135b209a09be8663.png[/img]

A small update including a few miscellaneous improvements and fixes :

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to pin a craft recipe to display the necessary ingredients on screen
[*]The shield can now be used simultaneously with C.L.I.C. attacks : a hotkey (X by default) allows you to quickly activate the shield without having to select it in the toolbar.
Once the shield is deactivated, the attack used will be automatically re-selected.
Additionally, the shield's charge level is now displayed in the center of the screen during use for better readability.
[i]You will now be able to better defend yourself against the aggressive creatures of the Exot galaxy![/i]
[*]A sarcophagus will only be placed on the ground if your inventory is not empty when Maurice dies
[*]If you attempt to use an attack when you don't have the appropriate ammo in your inventory, the message displayed will specify the type of ammo required for the selected attack
[*]It is now possible to replant mushrooms
[*]The option to automatically save the game every 10 minutes is now enabled by default (only valid for new installations of the game)
[*]The resources that will be harvested when mining a rock, a plant, etc. are now displayed in the center of the screen
[*]The image and quantity of resources collected from the ground are now briefly displayed in the center of the screen
[*]The unlockable C.L.I.C tool is now displayed in the center of the screen when you point your cursor over a resource you cannot yet collect
[/list]
[h3][b]INTERFACE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]It is now possible to choose the location of the HUDs (life gauge, hunger gauge, etc.) on the screen (location to be selected in the display options)
[*]It is now possible to assign a key to quickly place a marker on the map (WHEEL-CLICK by default)
[*]You can now define a custom color for each marker you place on the map
[*]The encyclopedia and crafting menu search areas are now automatically selected on the display to speed up the input
[/list]
[h3][b]MOBS ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Exolem behavior has been modified so that it no longer respawns after being defeated when you attempt to mine its rock (you will now have to move away from its area of ​​influence for it to respawn)
[*]Non-aggressive creatures (Fatosaurus, Lamouths, and Rabrels) will now attempt to avoid lava when fleeing after an attack
[*]It is now possible to feed non-aggressive creatures (Fatosaurus, Lamouths, and Rabrels) by selecting one of the fruits they consume from the toolbar.
If the creature is not yet an adult, feeding it will accelerate its growth (between 5 and 10 fruits to make it an adult).
If the creature is an adult, feeding it will regenerate its wool, milk, or substrate.
[i]Breeding should no longer be a problem for you![/i]
[*]You can now rename creatures you've incubated and Radeks you've hacked (right-click on the creature you want to rename)
[/list]
[h3][b]ADDED TIPS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a tip to describe the new shield functionality (this tip will appear the first time you take a hit from an aggressive creature)
[*]Added a tip to explain how to take control of a hacked Radek (this tip will appear once a Radek has been hacked)
[*]Added a tip explaining the behavior of Exolems (protecting their rock, attack methods, etc. - this tip will appear the first time an Exolem appears)
[/list]
[h3][b]FIXED BUGS[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed an anomaly that drastically increased the Radeks' attack speed when the player consumed a Ventoule Berry
[*]Fixed an anomaly that could leave a red outline around planted trees in certain cases
[*]Fixed an anomaly that blocked the mining sound of a rock if the player mined several rocks in a row
[*]Added security features when passing through portals to avoid certain blockages
[*]If the player dies near a wall of his spaceship, the sarcophagus will no longer land outside the spaceship
[*]Fixed an anomaly that allowed the Fartoons to attack the player even if they were in the area of ​​influence of an Exonhir
[*]Fixed an anomaly that allowed the Gorems to hit players even if their shield is activated in certain cases
[/list]
The full list of features in this update is available [url=https://discord.gg/BKMgAhjs]on our Discord[/url].

We look forward to your feedback to see if these adjustments work for you !

See you soon !

notes.title: Update 20250618-1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/090849257f5ecdbc0af94582135b209a09be8663.png[/img]

A small update including a few miscellaneous improvements and fixes :

[h3][b]GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]It is no longer possible to pick up or modify the signs indicating portals on other islands on a planet
    [*]Increased the speed of the "C.L.I.C Punch" attack
    [*]Modified the Radek's behavior to make it more mobile on the map
[/list]
[h3][b]SPECIAL EFFECTS ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Added a "ghosting" effect on Exolems when they rush towards the player
    [*]Added a "ghosting" effect on Pikeri when they attack
    [*]Added a "ghosting" effect on Gorems when they attack
    [*]Added a "ghosting" effect on Radeks during their avoidance movements (when they take a hit from the player)
    [*]Added a "ghosting" effect to the "C.L.I.C Punch" attack
[/list]
[h3][b]BUGS FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an anomaly that could prevent restarting a game created from the demo
    [*]Fixed an anomaly that switched to the inventory when typing the letter "I" in a search field (crafting menu, encyclopedia, etc.)
    [*]Modified the algorithm defining the Exolem rush speed (this speed tended to be faster on some PCs)
    [*]Fixed an anomaly that could allow the Radek to land a hit on the player in certain cases where they found themselves "stuck"
    [*]Fixed some translations
[/list]
The full list of features in this update is available [url=https://discord.gg/BKMgAhjs]on our Discord[/url].

We look forward to your feedback to see if these adjustments work for you !

See you soon !

    [*]Changed the cursor display when hovering over certain buttons (crafting ingredients, available crafts, etc.)
[/list]
[h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3]
[list]
    [*]Fixed an anomaly that prevented a trade from being validated with the merchant if the amount sold was the same as the amount purchased.
    [*]Fixed a visual anomaly when planting trees (roots displayed before planting was complete)
    [*]Fixed an anomaly that could display the hoverboard in the wrong position on the compass (visible when dying with a hoverboard in the inventory).
    [*]Fixed an anomaly that did not always prevent the lava pit from being placed anywhere other than on lava oceans
[/list]
The full list of features in this update is available [url=https://discord.gg/BKMgAhjs]on our Discord[/url].

We look forward to your feedback to see if these adjustments work for you !

We hope you have a great time with this demo, and that it inspires you to continue conquering the Exot galaxy in its full version !

notes.title: Customizable and more balanced galaxies
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/2f775449342cca9e571abc71a44d6ca3f92897d7.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

New features and adjustments are coming to the Exot galaxy!

[h3][b]GALAXY CUSTOMIZATION[/b][/h3]
We've finally finalized the update to the game creation interface!
Following player feedback, we've decided to offer more customization options for your galaxies. From now on, you can fine-tune the difficulty level in several ways, regardless of the chosen one :
[list]
    [*]Calorie consumption rate (with the possibility of deactivating hunger management)
    [*]Food expiration speed
    [*]General health of aggressive creatures
    [*]General damage level of aggressive creature attacks
    [*]Ability to select the spawn rate of each aggressive creature ("none", "less", or "normal")
[/list]
[h3][b]BALANCE ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
Following our observations of Exot live streams, we felt it was necessary to modify certain game balance values :
[list]
    [*]Reduced the unlock price for the circuit board recipe
    [*]Increased stack size to 50 (from 20)
    [*]Added 40 additionnal copper cartridge and 40 additionnal slingshot's ammunition in the starter pack
    [*]Removed spawnpoints generation on medium islands (in some cases you could respawn on a remote island without being able to leave)
[/list]
[h3][b]GAMEPLAY ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/h3]
We've also adjusted some gameplay and interface elements :
[list]
    [*]Automatically launch recipes in workshops when fuel is added (if the ingredients are already loaded)
    [*]Increased the compass display distance of custom markers placed on the map
    [*]Reduced the brightness of the portal animation (which could be a little too bright on some PCs)
    [*]Added new ambient music
[/list]
We've also, of course, fixed the bugs reported to us since the last update.

The full list of features in this update is available [url=https://discord.gg/BKMgAhjs]on our Discord[/url].

We look forward to your feedback to see if these adjustments work for you !

See you soon !

notes.title: Musical atmospheres and fair fights
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/b123c83c1f82c63670ea301a3918c1e046b4e698.png[/img]

Hello everyone !

Today we're releasing a new update to the game, which brings adjustments to music management and the behavior of hostile creatures.

[h3][b]MUSIC AND ATMOSPHERE[/b][/h3]
To begin, we've changed the way music is integrated into the game. To add more variation to the soundtrack, we've decided to no longer play it continuously.
In addition, the music now corresponds to different atmospheres : resting in the ship, wandering the islands, navigating the menu, etc.

[h3][b]MOBS AND FIGHTS[/b][/h3]
As promised, we've adjusted the behavior of aggressive creatures to make combat more fair ;)
We've reduced the speed, health, and damage of Gorems and Pikeris. You should be able to escape them, and, for the more adventurous, confront them, with less difficulty!
We've also improved the firerate of weapons to make combat a little more "comfortable".

[h3][b]EXOLEM BEHAVIOR[/b][/h3]
Exolem behavior has also been changed. Before this update, Exolems launched their attack as soon as you entered their defense zone (about ten meters around their rock).
Now, if you enter this zone, they will simply observe you at first. They will only attack you if you get close enough to their rock to be able to mine it.
Of course, if you attack them from a distance, they will retaliate !

We look forward to your feedback to see if these adjustments work for you !

See you soon !

notes.title: The arrival of Creative Mode in Exot
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/b085baeb914f015f46ea1c3b8f980707c9ccd9e2.png[/img]

Hello everyone !

Today we're releasing our first major update for Exot : the Creative Mode !
This new mode brings a whole new dimension to the game.
A new gameplay experience awaits you : you can now explore the galaxy, free from any constraint, taking full advantage of its sandbox aspect.

You'll be able to create the spaceship of your dreams without worrying about gathering the necessary resources, completely develop your islands, and do whatever you can think of without having to defend yourself against the hostile creatures of this galaxy.

You'll also have the opportunity to test Exot's more complex mechanics to familiarize yourself with certain facets of the game.

Here are the details of all the actions available in a Creative Mode game :
[list]
    [*]Ability to craft the entire catalog (all recipes are unlocked)
    [*]Ability to build all the spaceship's rooms and walls
    [*]You start the game with all C.L.I.C. upgrades unlocked
    [*]You start the game with 1,000,000,000 Exols
    [*]No health or hunger management
    [*]No enemy spawning. You can, however, temporarily spawn them with the F3 key : this will allow you to test your supercharged weapons in real time !
    [*]No achievement management - that would be too easy ;)
[/list]
A few small adjustments have also been added in this update :
[list]
    [*]Ability to assign mouse keys to controls (except right and left clicks, which are reserved by the system)
    [*]No filling of the action bar when clicking the "Collect All" button in chests (the inventory will be filled first - the action bar will only be filled if the inventory is full)
    [*]Ability to overwrite an existing backup
[/list]
Following your feedback, we've learned that the Exotian creatures may have seemed a little too aggressive ;)
The next update will therefore mainly focus on balancing this aspect, to make the game more accessible to everyone !

Exot will remain a hostile galaxy, but we'll be making sure the fights are fairer, especially at the beginning of the game :)

See you soon !

Hello!

Exot's Playtest has been going on for a week now, and we've granted access to the game to about a hundred testers !
We've started receiving feedback on the game, but mainly by email or PM for now: it would be even more interesting if you could give us your opinions and ask us your questions on the Community Hub or on our Discord.
This would allow newcomers to learn more easily about the game, its mechanics and the topics already covered.

We're already preparing an update for next week that will include some adjustments based on your first suggestions.
We'll keep you informed as soon as it's deployed.

notes.title: Launch of the Exot PlayTest!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506887/ea7ef2f9e026ab780cac9eabc139d2de975f637e.png[/img]

Hello everyone !

✨We are happy to announce the launch of the Exot PlayTest ✨

For a few months, we have started a private testing program with a handful of insiders, and we would now like to get more feedback on the game.

To sign up for the PlayTest, simply go to the store page and click on "Request access".
This registration is free and without obligation: it will give you full access to Exot for the duration of the program.

We hope you enjoy the game and share your experience on the community hub or on your favorite networks.
We would like you to give us your general impressions of the game, what you liked and what could be improved.
We have already hunted for bugs in Exot, but these little critters can sometimes hide well 😉: do not hesitate to report any anomalies you may encounter !

You can give us your feedback on the following channels :
[list]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3546920/discussions/3/599645834905140098/]"Send us your Suggestions" Forum on the Community Hub[/url]
    [*][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3546920/discussions/2/599645834905140186/]"Bug Report" Forum on the Community Hub[/url]
    [*][url=https://discord.gg/ZE5s8khvNW]Request access to the testers' channel on Discord[/url]
[/list]
We can't wait to hear your thoughts on the game and to chat with you !

See you soon !
